description: Implement Dependency Scanner that analyzes node_modules for token impact. Creates a tool to understand external dependency context, extract type definitions, track imports, and identify security concerns.
steps: Create lib/analyzers/dependency-scanner.js with DependencyScanner class that analyzes node_modules
Implement package.json parsing to get all dependencies (dependencies + devDependencies)
Implement token counting for each dependency using existing Scanner/TokenCalculator
Create lib/analyzers/import-tracker.js that parses source files to track which packages are actively imported
Implement security vulnerability checking using npm audit or similar
Implement TypeScript definition extraction (.d.ts files) from dependencies
Create dependency context generator that produces dependency-context.json
Create test/import-tracker.test.js for import tracking tests
Ensure all tests pass with npm test
acceptance_criteria: lib/analyzers/dependency-scanner.js exists and exports DependencyScanner class
lib/analyzers/import-tracker.js exists and exports ImportTracker class
--scan-dependencies flag analyzes node_modules and lists dependencies with token counts
Identifies actively imported packages by parsing source files
Security vulnerability checking works (integrated with npm audit)
TypeScript definition extraction works when --include-types is used
All existing tests continue to pass
verification: Run npm test and verify all tests pass including new tests
Run node bin/cli.js --scan-dependencies to verify dependency scanning works
findings:
Implementation notes:
1. Security checking is opt-in with --check-security flag because npm audit can be slow
2. Added 5-second timeout per dependency for token counting to prevent hanging on large packages
3. All 1211 tests pass including 57 new tests for the dependency scanner modules
